messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: kv-cache contended eviction surge detected on shard pool-gamma at 08:12 UTC — auto-escalating to #incidents. summary: sudden growth in live KV refs + continuous-batching backlog.

leo: seeing proto-level RTT spikes and 5xxs for a subset of dedicated clusters. dashboards -> https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv/kv-cache?from=now-30m  

amanda: logs show repeated OOM-like eviction churn, paging thrash. large prefixes from a few tenants (t-881, t-903).

chris: tagging @oncall-monica — can you confirm if any customer pages are complaining?

oncall-monica: ack I'm up. CS just reported a ticket from AcmeCorp (dedicated-us-east) reporting slow generations (~3-6s vs 200-400ms).

leo: root cause hypothesis: recent continuous-batching change increased max-inflight per-conn and disabled soft-prefetch; long-lived requests keep large KV entries hot -> eviction loop + increased page reclaim -> latency cliff for mixed short/long requests.

amanda: reproducer in staging: run mixed 10ms embeddings + 3s streaming chat -> cache size oscillates and paging rate doubles.

chris: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily cap continuous-batch window to 150ms 2) re-enable soft-prefetch 3) bump paging-throttle to 30/s per-gpu 4) enable per-tenant eviction limits for top-5 offending tenants.

leo: pushing hotfix branch and config: 
```
# hotfix patch (runtime config)
continuous_batch.max_window_ms = 150
continuous_batch.enable_soft_prefetch = true
kv.paging.throttle_per_gpu = 30
kv.eviction.per_tenant_limit = true
kv.eviction.top_tenants = ["t-881","t-903","t-914"]
```

amanda: applying to prod-canaries now (pool-gamma-canary-1,2). watching RPS/latency.

incident-bot: DEPLOY started by leo to production(canary) at 08:28 UTC — job: deploy/runtime-hotfix-209. check: https://deploys.redwood.example/jobs/209

julie: pinging product-ops for customer comms triage. impact window estimate?

product-ops: Apriori impact: small fraction of dedicated customers on pool-gamma may see increased latency and occasional 5xxs from 08:10-08:35 UTC. prioritizing AcmeCorp support ticket.

amanda: canaries look good after config flip: paging rate down 60%, tail p99 latency back to baseline for short requests.

chris: rolling to remainder of pool-gamma; will stage rollout 5 nodes at a time with 2-minute verification.

incident-bot: ROLLING UPDATE initiated at 08:36 UTC by chris. nodes impacted: pool-gamma-[3..40].

leo: after ~10 nodes deployed, noticed one node with persistent high disk IO, evict backlog persists — isolating node for drain and replacing.

amanda: replaced node-17, drained, metrics normalized. continuing rollout.

oncall-monica: customer update sent to AcmeCorp: "we observed elevated latency due to a cache/paging regression; we applied a hotfix and are monitoring. we'll follow up with root cause and postmortem." :thumbsup:

product-ops: also flagged customers t-903 and t-914 for targeted outreach.

incident-bot: ROLLING UPDATE complete at 08:52 UTC. Verification window 30m in progress.

chris: verification after 30m: p50/p95/p99 all within normal bounds, paging ops at expected baseline, no new 5xx trends. marking incident as mitigated for customer impact.

leo: short-term actions: revert continuous-batching change that increased per-conn inflight (PR #4123), add per-tenant cache caps, add alarm for eviction-thrashing that includes paging-rate and kv-ref-growth combined.

amanda: follow-ups: add a staged canary with mixed short/long synthetic workload in CI, increase observability for per-tenant cache heatmaps.

julie: ops->cs handoff notes for post-incident: timeline, affected tenants, support tickets, customer emails sent. I'll create a canned follow-up template.

oncall-monica: handing to night oncall @leo-night for 12h watch - will include runbook steps: if paging > 2x baseline -> enable emergency throttle 15/s and rollback batch window.

leo: ack handoff, will monitor overnight. assigning postmortem owner: chris. estimated postmortem by EOD tomorrow.

product-ops: tagging internal stakeholders for RCA: eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated (customer impact: limited; high-latency window 25m; affected dedicated tenants: t-881,t-903,t-914; follow-ups: PR rollback + postmortem)

chris: closing thread for active mitigation. will post postmortem link when ready. thanks team :heart:
